note: Observational associations are non-causal; none of the six preregistered Google writing factors passed FDR in development or fresh data. ChatGPT adjusted effects are unestimable.

factors.name: unique_verifiable_information
applies_when: document can add supplied firsthand data, method, analysis, or experience
does_not_apply_when: page is a commodity announcement with no additional evidence
factors.intervention: Add only supplied unique evidence and its scope; otherwise ask for proof or recommend an owned analysis page.

factors.name: direct_scoped_answer
applies_when: document can answer a likely query without losing caveats
factors.intervention: Place a concise scoped answer beside the relevant descriptive heading, followed by nuance.

factors.name: evidence_and_attribution
applies_when: material claims have supplied evidence or attribution
does_not_apply_when: citations would be decorative or unrelated
factors.intervention: Name source, date, method/population, and supported claim without increasing citation count for its own sake.

factors.name: entity_clarity
applies_when: entity, acronym, product, person, or relationship is ambiguous
factors.intervention: Disambiguate the first reference once; avoid repeated entity stuffing.

factors.name: descriptive_coherent_structure
applies_when: answers are buried or sections mix jobs
factors.intervention: Use descriptive headings and single-purpose chunks without forcing question headings.

factors.name: intent_fit_format
does_not_apply_when: narrative or announcement does not benefit from a table/list
factors.intervention: Use a table for genuine comparisons or steps for a procedure; never add a fake FAQ.

factors.name: legitimate_freshness
applies_when: query is time-sensitive and a real date is supplied
factors.intervention: Expose the real effective, measured, published, or updated date beside the claim.

factors.name: neutral_qualified_specificity
applies_when: draft uses unsupported promotion or absolutes
does_not_apply_when: strong claim is fully supported and appropriately scoped
factors.intervention: Replace promotional abstraction with the supported outcome, scope, and limitation while preserving voice.

factors.name: human_readability_with_precision
factors.disposition: supported human/safety guard; visibility effect insufficient
does_not_apply_when: simplification would erase necessary terminology or caveats
factors.intervention: Clarify syntax while preserving the intended register and all qualifications.

factors.name: anti_repetition_and_padding
factors.disposition: supported human/safety guard; visibility effect insufficient
applies_when: keywords, headings, FAQs, or summary blocks repeat without reader value
does_not_apply_when: repetition is technically or rhetorically necessary
factors.intervention: Remove redundant repetition and checklist padding; do not optimize term frequency.
